svg.title: Simulated test bench
svg.text: MPX SPIN V1 (CONCEPT 04 DEVELOPED) · DESIGN REVIEW
The simulated test bench: four states

text.tspan: An interactive bench driven by the same model: separatory funnel doses the batch, the spout pours through a carbon cup into a jug on a scale, a
stopwatch times it, the sleeve goes under the microscope.
The rig as calibrated. The motor is at 5,000 rpm but the
water turns at 326 rpm: it slumps in the basket and
Vanes on. The water stands against the sleeve at 55 g
and is through in about 28 s per 400 mL.
Same basket and sleeve, vanes removed: the water
lags like the rig's and the fine paper passes only
Lid aside, basket out, sleeve flattened on the tray
Desktop › MPx › Centrifuge_v1 › figure › MPx_Spin_v1_TestBench.html. Sliders for speed, batch, temperature; paper grade, vanes, water and the experiment's three conditions.
